structured.answer: I haven't decided anything. It looks like 0.07% each time you buy or sell (at least 2 ₪), 0.03% every quarter, no monthly fee, and at least 10,000 ₪ to open. You can buy mutual funds, but there are no deposits, the dollar exchange price wasn't clear to me, and the advertising says things the documents contradict, so I'll ask my son or the bank before opening anything.
